summary: Infrastructure capacity and performance engineer with deep Python expertise and practical AI workflow automation. Experienced in large-scale telemetry ETL, forecasting, observability, and performance optimization across enterprise environments. Combines historical C++ optimization work with current AI-assisted reporting and agentic pipeline development. Focused on reproducible engineering workflows, data quality, and translating complex operational systems into maintainable, high-performance solutions.

experience.title: Capacity & Performance Specialist
bullets: Automated capacity-report preparation with AI and multiple data sources, improving standardization and report quality.
Used AI-assisted processes to integrate JIRA, Microsoft SQL Server and Splunk as automated capacity-data sources.
Used Copilot, AI and Python to organize, catalog and support migration of Power BI reports.
Researched an LLM-enabled team knowledge base and analyst command-center concept using Python and PowerShell; research/investigation, not production.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Built Python/Pandas ETL for P95 telemetry from 6,000+ endpoints, adding validation, cleansing, anomaly checks and Oracle history.
Developed Python and scikit-learn forecasting models to identify capacity risks 3-6 months ahead and support provisioning and rightsizing.
Managed enterprise capacity requests, monthly reporting and seasonal analysis with BMC TrueSight, CA APM and AppDynamics.

experience.title: Performance Engineer
bullets: Managed Dynatrace AppMon/Synthetics, analyzed performance bottlenecks and supported an AWS migration.

experience.title: SME for CA APM (Senior Consultant)
bullets: Delivered CA APM consulting for estates of roughly 4,000-6,000 agents and 50+ Enterprise Managers, including sizing, monitoring design and client training.

experience.title: Senior Systems & Data Migration Engineer
bullets: Migrated a shopping engine from 200+ MySQL nodes to six-node Oracle RAC, optimizing C++/OCCI processing with approximately 95% less hardware and sub-second latency.

skills.Professional experience: Python, SQL / Oracle, Pandas, ETL Design & Optimization, Capacity Planning / Forecasting, CA APM / Introscope, Dynatrace (AppMon + Synthetics), BMC TrueSight / TSCO, Prophet / Time-Series Forecasting, scikit-learn, Data Quality, Testing & Pipeline Monitoring
